operating_notes.text: Entered into a manufacturing agreement with TS Conductor Corp, USA to manufacture HTLS Carbon Core Conductors using patented Aluminum Encapsulated Carbon Core technology.
Unutilized preferential issue proceeds of ₹11.19 Cr invested in Mutual Funds as of March 31, 2026.
Renewable segment grew by 100% in FY26, contributing ~19% of total revenue.
Order book stood at ₹808 crores as of March 31, 2026.
Greenfield plant production targeted to start by September 2026.
Installed plant and machinery at newly established manufacturing facility located at Reengus, Sikar, Rajasthan, boosting production capacity by ~20%.
Standalone financial results for Q2FY27 approved by board on October 27, 2026.

timeline.summary: Dynamic Cables entered into a manufacturing agreement with USA-based TS Conductor Corp to produce patented HTLS carbon core conductors.
Promoters—Mr. Ashish Mangal, Mr. Rahul Mangal, Mrs. Saroj Mangal, and others—confirmed no new encumbrances on Dynamic Cables Limited shares under SEBI’s Regulation 31(4) as of April 3, 2026.
Q4FY26 results (standalone): revenue ₹355.46 Cr (+7.3% YoY), net profit ₹24.17 Cr (+2.6% YoY).
Dynamic Cables Limited’s Board of Directors, led by Naina Gupta, recommended a final dividend of ₹0.50 per share (5% of face value) for FY2026, pending AGM approval on May 12, 2026.
Naina Gupta, Director, disclosed the audio recording link for the Q4FY26 earnings conference call held on May 12, 2026, via the company’s website.
Dynamic Cables released its FY26 corporate presentation highlighting a 17% revenue increase to ₹1,198 Cr and an order book of ₹808 Cr.
Dynamic Cables hosted its Q4 FY26 earnings call, guiding for greenfield plant commercial production by September 2026.
Dynamic Cables installed plant and machinery at its new Reengus facility, increasing overall capacity by ~20%.
Dynamic Cables reported standalone Q2FY27 revenue of ₹363.19 Cr and PAT of ₹22.15 Cr.
Dynamic Cables Limited uploaded the audio recording of the Analysts/Investors Call held on 27.10.2026 discussing un-audited financial results for the quarter and half-year ended 30.09.2026.
